Definition: from G303 and θάλλω (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this one word once, telling the Philippians that their care for him has flourished again, like a plant putting out fresh growth after winter. The picture is of something coming back to life, not starting from nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: One picture of care blooming again carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is Paul's joy that the Philippians' love for him had found fresh expression.
